artifacts.summary: Diagnoses siting (a/b/c) for the task-description filing-vs-proposal-packet convention; recommends stating it once in multi-task-creation-standard.md Component 7, with a pointer-only note in conclusion-stage.md, and pointing (not re-specifying) the existing issue-log suggested_channel shape as the proposal packet.

memory_candidates.content: In this codebase's source store, docs/reference/standards/multi-task-creation-standard.md is referenced by /task, /meta, /fix-it, /review, meta-builder-agent, and skill-fix-it, but NOT by planner-agent.md, reviser-agent.md, spawn-agent.md, or general-implementation-agent.md. Any convention meant to reach plan-authoring or implementation-executing agents cannot rely on that document alone being read; it needs either a second pointer at a doc those agents do consult, or an update to those agent files themselves.

conclusion-stage.md's channels (b) and (c) never dispatch or create anything synchronously; they only append events.jsonl evidence. The actual Component-7-compliant confirmed task/change creation happens later and separately, via /telemetry --meta delegating to meta-builder-agent (the current name for what the contract's prose calls '/distill --meta'). Read 'routes ... through a confirmed dispatch' in that contract as describing this eventual, batched consumption chain, not an immediate action inside Step 4b/4c themselves.

docs/reference/standards/agent-frontmatter-standard.md's 'Tool Withholding from Dispatched Subagents (Measured)' section is the canonical, mechanically-measured citation for 'AskUserQuestion is unreachable from a dispatched agent' -- stronger than Component 7's own 'does not reliably surface' phrasing (categorical withholding across 5 live dispatches/4 configs, not merely unreliable). Cite this section rather than re-deriving or re-measuring the claim in future work that needs this justification.
